shortDesc: A member's profile: avatar (photo or initial), display name, karma, post and comment counts, join date and bio. Give it the user-id, or nothing for the signed-in member; it loads the profile itself.

props.name: user-id
props.description: Member's user id. Omit for the signed-in member's own profile.

styling.notes: 64px round avatar with a pine initial on pale green when there's no photo; Archivo 800 name; tabular stats.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'get a member profile', userId?, outputFormat: { displayName, photoURL, bio, memberSince, postCount, commentCount, karma } }
